moves.selfApprove: In the alpha you may approve your own question once you have gone through the list. In the beta someone else approves it where possible.
moves.dateHelp: One question per day. It goes live at 00:00 UTC.
moves.timeless: The question does not depend on a date or event and makes sense at any time.

moves.withdrawnLead: The question is withdrawn. Members no longer see it or its answers; nothing was deleted.

alphaPage.title: About the alpha
alphaPage.lead: GrooveRift is in a closed technical alpha: an early, unfinished version for a small group of invited adults.
alphaPage.whatText: Only part of what GrooveRift is meant to become: the Daily Drop, a profile with Music DNA, following, and reporting and blocking. The rest comes in the beta.
alphaPage.limit1: No messages, posts or people suggestions yet. They come later.
alphaPage.limit2: Profile photos come later. Until then a profile shows an initial.
alphaPage.feedbackText: A feedback form will be in the app, under Help. A contact address is published before the first invitations.
alphaPage.dataText: Data is stored on servers in the EU. The privacy policy describes what we process and for how long.
alphaPage.afterText: We delete nothing without notice. Whether alpha accounts and answers carry over to the beta will be announced before the first invitations.

first.title: The first question arrives on {date}
first.releaseUtc: A new question every day at 00:00 UTC. The same question for everyone.
first.releaseLocal: At {time} your time (00:00 UTC). The same question for everyone, every day.
first.countdownSr: About {hours} h and {minutes} min to the first question.
first.archiveStarts: The archive starts with the first question.

public.joinText: GrooveRift is in a closed alpha: members invite people they know. If you have an account, sign in and we'll bring you back to this question.

image.altHelp: For screen readers and when the image doesn't load. If you leave it empty, it reads “Image added by” and your name.

activity.reactionMany: Reactions to your answer: {a}, {c} and {n} more.
activity.emptyText: Comments and reactions on your answers and new followers show up here.
activity.moderation: A moderation decision about your account or content. Read the reasons.

report.action: Your report was decided: action was taken.
report.none: Your report was decided: no breach was found.

mute.title: Mute @{username}?
mute.text: Their answers and comments will fold into one line you can open. They won't know, and nothing else changes.

block.title: Block @{username}?
block.fact1: Neither you nor @{username} will see each other's profiles, answers and comments while signed in.
block.fact2: Follows end both ways, and requests are removed.
block.fact3: They aren't notified, but they may notice they can no longer see your profile.
block.fact4: The name and bio of a public profile can still be opened without signing in, through a link. A private profile is the stronger option.
block.fact5: You can unblock any time. Follows don't come back on their own.
block.done: Blocked. @{username} can no longer see your profile or answers.

unblock.title: Unblock @{username}?
unblock.fact1: Follows don't come back on their own.
unblock.fact2: @{username} can see your profile and answers again, depending on your privacy settings.

report.title: Report
report.question: What's wrong?
report.detailsHint: What happened? It helps the moderator.
report.private: The person you report never learns who reported them. A person reviews every report.
report.copyright: For copyright the law asks for a separate form with details about the work and the right holder. It works without an account too.
report.doneText: A person on our team reviews it. You'll see the decision in Settings, under Account status → My reports. In the alpha this may take a few days.
report.aboutImage: The report is about the image

hate.name: Hate
hate.desc: Attacks on people for who they are.

threat.name: Threats or violence
threat.desc: A threat of harm or a call to violence. Reviewed first.

minor.name: Someone under 18
minor.desc: An account or content of a minor. Reviewed first.

impersonation.name: Impersonation
impersonation.desc: Pretends to be another person, an artist or a company. Reviewed first.

copyright.name: Copyright
copyright.desc: Someone else's music, text or image without permission.

ai_generated.name: AI content passed off as own
ai_generated.desc: Text or images made by AI, presented as human work.

private_info.name: Someone's private information
private_info.desc: An address, a number, photos or messages shared without consent.

error.notAllowed: You can't do this right now.
error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
error.invalid: Check the text: it's empty or too long.
error.closed: The time to appeal has passed.
error.exists: An appeal against this decision was already sent.

chip.mutedSr: Muted, only you can see this

removedWarning.profile: Profile content removed, with a warning

effect.content_removal: The content was removed. No other consequence for the account.
effect.warning: This is a warning. A further breach may mean a posting restriction.
effect.restriction: Until {date} you can't post answers or comments. Reading, reactions and following still work. The restriction ends by itself.
effect.suspension: Until {date} you can't use GrooveRift. Your profile, answers and comments are hidden from others meanwhile.
effect.ban: The account is permanently closed. Your profile, answers and comments are hidden from others.

how.report: A member's report and a moderator's review, with no automated decision-making.
how.notice: An illegal content notice (DSA) and a moderator's review, with no automated decision-making.
how.staff: A moderator's review, with no automated decision-making.

rule.ai: Don't pass off AI as your own work

sor.noCopy: The copy of the content no longer exists.
sor.revoked: The decision was reversed after an appeal.
sor.appealUntil: You can appeal until {date}. Another person on the team reviews appeals where possible.
sor.appealClosed: The time to appeal ended on {date}.
sor.appealSent: Appeal sent on {date}. Another person on the team reviews it where possible. The decision stays in force meanwhile.
sor.appealOverturned: Appeal accepted: the decision is reversed.
sor.draft: Draft: the wording of statements of reasons is still under legal review.

appeal.label: Why do you think the decision is wrong?
appeal.help: Another person on the team reviews appeals where possible. The decision stays in force meanwhile.
appeal.empty: Write why you think the decision is wrong.
appeal.sent: Appeal sent. The outcome arrives in Activity and here.

status.title: Account status
status.fine: Your account is in good standing
status.restrictedText: Reading, reactions and following still work.
status.noticesCount: {count, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} · latest {date}
status.reportsCount: {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}}{open, plural, =0 {} other { · in review}}
status.note: Every moderation decision comes with reasons: what, which rule, what was decided and how to appeal.
status.noticesEmptyText: If moderation decides anything about your content, the reasons arrive here.
status.reportsEmptyText: You send reports from ⋯ on an answer, a comment or a profile.
status.reportsNote: You only see the status of your own reports. You learn nothing about the other person, and they learn nothing about you.
status.thanksAction: Thanks for reporting. Action was taken under the Community Guidelines; for privacy reasons we can't say which.
status.thanksNone: Thanks for reporting. Our review found no breach of the Community Guidelines. If it happens again, feel free to report again.
status.inReview: A person reviews your report. In the alpha this may take a few days.

lists.title: Blocked and muted
lists.blockedNote: Blocked accounts can't see your profile or answers, and you can't see theirs. They aren't notified.
lists.mutedNote: You can still visit muted accounts; only their answers and comments are folded. They don't know.

lead.restriction: Until then you can't post answers or comments. Everything else works: reading, reactions and following. The restriction ends by itself.
lead.suspension: Until then you can't use GrooveRift. Your profile and answers are hidden from others. The reasons and the appeal are below.
lead.ban: You can no longer use GrooveRift. Your profile and answers are hidden from others. The reasons and the appeal are below.

queue.meta: {reports, plural, =0 {no member reports} one {# report} other {# reports}} · {date}

conflict.self: This case is about you: you can't open it.
conflict.involved: Conflict of interest: decide only if nobody else can.

case.forbidden: You can't open this: it's assigned to someone else, it's about you, or you're involved.
case.logged: Every view of the evidence is logged.

conflict.involved: You're involved in this case: you reported it, or someone in it blocked you. Decide only if nobody else can, and state the reason.

case.subject: Reported member
case.copy: Copy at the time of the report
case.reportersHidden: Reporters aren't shown, not even to moderators.
case.imageAlt: The image from the reported content

decide.noneHelp: Reporters are told no breach was found. The member the case is about hears nothing.
decide.statementHelp: The member reads this under “Decision”. Say exactly what was breached and why, without naming reporters.
decide.freshNote: A suspension or a permanent closure needs a sign-in within the last 15 minutes.
decide.overrideHelp: This goes into the audit log.
decide.removeImage: Remove only the image (the text stays)

appeal.title: Appeals
appeal.own: This is your decision: someone else should review the appeal.
appeal.ownWarn: This is your decision. Another person on the team should review the appeal; if there is none, review it carefully and afresh.
appeal.textHelp: The member reads this with the outcome. Reversing restores removed content and the account.
appeal.involved: Conflict of interest: you reported this case or someone in it blocked you. Decide only if nobody else can, and state the reason.

error.subject: There's no member behind this: record a note only.

error.tooMany: Too many actions. Wait a little.
error.text: Write the reasons for the member.
error.gone: The case is no longer open.

error.notAllowed: That is not possible right now.
error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

error.image: The screenshot wasn't accepted: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB.

close.title: Deactivate or delete account
close.staff: An account with a team role cannot be deactivated or deleted while it has the role. Ask an administrator to remove it first.
close.chooseTitle: What would you like to do?
close.copyTitle: Would you like a copy of your data first?
close.copyText: Profile, answers, comments, Music DNA and settings in one ZIP file. You can also skip this.
close.freshNote: You signed in with Google a moment ago, so no password is needed.
close.reauthNote: This account has no password. Sign in again with Google to confirm, then come back here.

deactivate.title: Deactivate
deactivate.desc: Your profile and answers are hidden. When you sign in again, everything comes back.
deactivate.f1: Your profile, Music DNA and answers are hidden, and you are signed out on every device.
deactivate.f2: Nobody can find or follow you.
deactivate.f3: When you sign in again, everything comes back.

delete.title: Delete permanently
delete.desc: Your account is hidden now and deleted on {date}. Until then you can change your mind.
delete.f1: Your account is hidden now and you are signed out on every device.
delete.f2: On {date} we delete your profile, Music DNA, answers, comments and reactions.
delete.f3: Until then you can sign in and restore your account.
delete.f4: Some records must be kept longer because the law requires it. The privacy policy explains this.

copy.preparing: Your copy is being prepared. Stay here or come back later; we will also tell you by email.
copy.readyText: ZIP, about {kb} kB. The link works for 24 hours.
copy.failed: The copy could not be made. Try again.

pending.title: Your account will be deleted on {date}.
pending.lead: Deletion was requested on {requested}. Until {date} you can restore your account and everything stays as it was.
pending.restored: Your account is back. Everything is as it was.

closed.deactivatedText: Your profile and answers are hidden. When you sign in again, everything comes back.
closed.deletedText: A confirmation is on its way by email. If you change your mind, sign in before that date and restore your account.

google.title: Google
google.linked: Linked. You can also sign in with the Google account that has the same address.
google.onlyWay: Google is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be unlinked.
google.linkFailed: Linking failed. The Google account must have the same email address.

language.title: Language and region
language.readingHelp: The languages you like to read answers in. Optional; nothing is hidden.
language.zoneHelp: For the reminder time. The Daily Drop comes out for everyone at the same moment.
